en.title: Christmas Hangman
en.subtitle: Get ready for å festive game of Hangman!
en.restartWarning: You will lose your win streak if you start a new game
en.languageChangeWarning: Changing language will reset your win streak
en.instructionsText: Guess the hidden Christmas word, one letter at a time. Be careful not to make many wrong guesses or the gingerbread man won't survive!

no.title: Julehangman
no.subtitle: Gjør deg klar for en julete Hangman!
no.restartWarning: Du vil miste seiersrekka di om du starter et nytt spill
no.languageChangeWarning: Bytter du språk mister du seiersrekka di
no.instructionsText: Gjett det skjulte juleordet, en bokstav om gangen. Pass på å ikke gjette feil for mange ganger slik at du kan redde pepperkakemannen!
